name: APT Mirror
description: Points the default apt sources of Ubuntu and Debian at a different mirror.

mirror.description: The URL to use instead of the distribution's default archive (e.g. 'http://jp.archive.ubuntu.com/ubuntu' on Ubuntu, 'http://ftp.jp.debian.org/debian' on Debian). Leave empty to keep the default.

security_mirror.description: The URL to use instead of the distribution's default security archive. Leave empty to keep security updates coming straight from the distribution's own server; mirrors sync on their own schedule and can lag behind it.
